The championship provides a platform for drivers and teams to showcase their skills and compete for the title against competitors from around the world.

programme.title: Scottish Rally Championship 2026
programme.desc: The 2026 Championship will be held over seven events, with five gravel rounds and two tarmac rounds, offering something for everyone.

programme.title: TER Series 2026: BCIC Rally Barbados, Barbados
programme.desc: A European rally series based on glorious rallies around Europe.

programme.title: Rally 2026
programme.desc: GTC Rally, Holland

programme.title: Africa Eco Race 2025
programme.desc: The Africa Eco Race takes adventurers through Africa’s deserts and wilderness, testing endurance and navigation in a grueling rally-raid from Morocco to Dakar. Epic motorsport moments await.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Mercedes C111 . Experimental- and research car from 1969. Design and engineering aren't common for the mostly conservative brand. On the outside gull-winged GFK-vehicle body, under the hood, you can find a three-shim rotary engine with 280 horse power. Later on Mercedes equips two C111s with 3,5-litre V8 motors. One of them is ready to start, and Classic Ride will test it on the road , today. Everybody is fascinated by the Mercedes C111! Additionally in this episode: A coupe , as elegant as a cocktail dress by Chanel and as solid as a medieval castle: The Mercedes 280 SE 3.5 coupe. The noble vehicle is one of the most reliable Oldies in the world. And especially the V8-motorised version

programme.title: Supercars: Mobility of Tomorrow
programme.desc: This is AMG's vision of an electric future: The Concept AMG GT XX delivers an unbelievable 1,360 horsepower and charges faster than you can say “range anxiety.” We were there for the spectacular world premiere. And: This racer looks like it came straight out of a retro film – but it’s actu-ally the brand-new top model from Morgan. We reveal five exciting facts about this British masterpiece.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The Jaguar XF-S is supposed to put pressure on BMW, Audi and co. in the business class segment. With V6 power, 380 HP output and all-wheel drive it wants to teach the German top dogs the true meaning of the word fear. Volvo takes a different approach. The S90 is captivating due to its Scandinavian design and economical four-cylinder engines.

programme.title: Fastzone 2025: Episode 35
programme.desc: Your weekly racing update in just 30 minutes. From prototypes and endurance racing to karting, airplanes, and oddities, Fastzone covers it all. With nearly 30 years of tradition, Fastzone is your ultimate source for everything fast and fascinating!

programme.title: DTM 2025
programme.desc: The Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM) thrills with close GT3 racing, featuring top drivers and teams competing on iconic circuits across Germany and Europe. High-octane motorsport at its finest.

programme.title: All Wheel Drive Safari Challenge 2025: Round 7, Whaddon
programme.desc: Every year, the British All Wheel Drive Club organises the AWDC Safari Championship, which has become the largest off-road event in the UK. Modified 4x4 vehicles of all brands can participate in the competition. Those who want to score points here must complete the challenging courses of mud, slush and scree in the shortest possible time.

programme.title: Australian Drag Racing Championship 2024: Nitro Funny Cars Round 5, Sydney
programme.desc: The "Australian Drag Racing Championship" is a regional motorsport series for top fuel dragsters that exceed speeds of roughly 300 mp/h in under 5 seconds

programme.title: FIM Quadcross World Championship 2026
programme.desc: The FIM QuadCross World Championship (formerly EMX Quad European Championship) is the premier international competition for quad bike motocross.

programme.title: Monster Jam Championship 2025: Detroit, Michigan
programme.desc: An adrenaline-charged motorsport features larger-than-life monster trucks driven by world-class athletes competing in racing, freestyle and two-wheel skills at some of the most prestigious arenas and stadiums from around the world.

programme.title: Icelandic Formula Offroad 2025: Akureyri, Part 2
programme.desc: The Icelandic Formula Off-Road is one of the most extreme racing series in the world and demands everything from the teams and their specially built vehicles. Nearly vertical cliffs have to be climbed, demanding time challenges have to be solved or spectacular aquaplaning stunts have to be performed.

programme.title: US Pro Pulling 2023: Hillsboro, Wisconsin, Mini Rods
programme.desc: Tractor pulling is a competitive motorsport where modified tractors or trucks pull a heavy sled along a specified distance within a track. The sport is known for its powerful machines and intense competition.

programme.title: US Pro Pulling 2023: Goshen, Indiana, 2 Wheel Drive Trucks
programme.desc: Tractor pulling is a competitive motorsport where modified tractors or trucks pull a heavy sled along a specified distance within a track. The sport is known for its powerful machines and intense competition.

programme.title: GT World Challenge America 2026: Sonoma Raceway
programme.desc: GT World Challenge America is the premier North American GT series. Taking place on the best US circuits form Sonoma to Indianapolis, each of the seven race weekends features 90-min double-header races.

programme.title: GT World Challenge Asia 2026: Sepang International Circuit, Malaysia
programme.desc: The GT World Challenge Asia is back for another season with five scheduled events for the season. Unlike its European and North American counterparts, GT World Challenge Asia also features GT4 entries.

programme.title: FIA European Truck Racing Series 2026
programme.desc: The FIA European Truck Racing Championship is the biggest, most imposing racing series in the world. The racing trucks are equipped with 1200 hp engines doing up to 100 miles per hour. On a grid with 26 big rigs the 5.5-ton machines doing battle there’s guaranteed action-packed lights-to-flag racing galore.

programme.title: GT World Challenge Australia 2026: Queensland Raceway
programme.desc: The GT World Series Australia delivers high-octane GT3 racing Down Under. Professional drivers and top Amateurs battle wheel-to-wheel on some of Australia’s most challenging circuits in this fiercely competitive championship. Expect close racing, stunning machinery and passionate crowds as the world’s finest GT3 cars light up the Australian tracks.

programme.title: GT World Challenge Europe 2026: Circuit de Nevers Magny-Cours, France
programme.desc: The GT World Challenge Europe is back for another season. The schedule consists of 10 rounds at high-level circuits, split evenly between the Endurance Cup and Sprint Cup. And once again, the calendar features the Total 24 Hours of Spa as the marquee event.

programme.title: Porsche Carrera Cup Germany 2026: Red Bull Ring, Spielberg, Austria
programme.desc: Coverage of the Porsche Carrera Cup.

programme.title: NZ Speedway Championship 2026: NZ Midget Title
programme.desc: Speedway is the sport of 2,500 full-time competitors and over 2,300 casual competitors and their 8,000 odd crew totalling around 12,800 crew and competitors throughout New Zealand. Speedway excitement is experienced every week throughout the summer season from Labour weekend until Easter. From some 23 venues our weekend warriors travel the land to entertain fans and share in the exhilaration that only Speedway can provide.

programme.title: European Le Mans Series 2026: 4 Hours of Le Castellet, Circuit Paul Ricard, France
programme.desc: The European Le Mans Series is a multiclass endurance championship with several races across Europe

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Convertibles with plenty of power. Porsche 911 Targa - the cult classic par excellence! Extreme lightweight Construction. The Lotus Seven Twin Cam SS - more race - than road car. This car demands the whole man. The 1930 Bentley Blower. And Sunbeam Tiger. A large V8 heart beats In this dainty English Roadster.

programme.title: Supercars: Fascination Mercedes S-Class
programme.desc: It is regarded as the most successful luxury sedan in the world — a synonym for comfort and opulence — and it sets the benchmark when it comes to technology and safety: the Mercedes S-Class. But why is that? What makes this vehicle so special and sets it apart from all others? We drive every generation, from the 450 SEL 6.9 to the current S 580 e, and explore the fascination behind each model.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Cruising on the motorways is so boring. Then off-road you go! 4x4 shows how sporty and elegant SUVs really are, and which vehicles can make your day on exciting off-road tracks.

programme.title: Fastzone 2025: Episode 31
programme.desc: Your weekly racing update in just 30 minutes. From prototypes and endurance racing to karting, airplanes, and oddities, Fastzone covers it all. With nearly 30 years of tradition, Fastzone is your ultimate source for everything fast and fascinating!

programme.title: DTM 2025
programme.desc: The Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters (DTM) thrills with close GT3 racing, featuring top drivers and teams competing on iconic circuits across Germany and Europe. High-octane motorsport at its finest.

programme.title: Pikes Peak International Hill Climb: Episode 1
programme.desc: The legendary Pikes Peak International Hillclimb returns to the 156-turn, 12.42-mile mountain course known as "The Race to the Clouds". Drivers battle against gravity, thin air and unforgiving terrain as they push their machines to the absolute limit in one of the most spectacular and dangerous motorsport events in the world.

programme.title: Koordinations och uthållighetsträning - Koordinaatio- ja kestävyysharjoittelu
programme.desc: Tässä jaksossa keskitytään koordinaatio-ja kestävyysharjoitteluun fysioterapeutti Doran kanssa. Jumppa toteutetaan istuen tuoli apuvälineenä. Jumpan tavoite on lisätä kestävyyttä ja haastaa koordinaatiota turvallisella tavalla. Jumppa on ruotsiksi.

programme.title: Tervetuloa Kotiin
programme.desc: Turvallista asumista ikääntyville. Sarjassa tapaamme mielenkiintoisia ikäihmisiä, jotka ovat päättäneet asua ja pärjätä kotona mahdollisimman pitkään. Ohjelmassa jaetaan vinkkejä turvalliseen asumiseen. Ohjelma on tekstitetty ruotsiksi.

programme.title: Istumafysio - Liikeradat ja liikkuvuus
programme.desc: Jo pienikin liike saa aikaan hyvän olon tunteen kehossa sekä ylläpitää ja parantaa toimintakykyä. Tule mukaan jumppaamaan koko kehoa erilaisten liikkuvuutta ja lihasvoimaa lisäävien harjoitteiden avulla. Jos haluat haastaa itseäsi, voit tehdä jumpan myös seisten.

programme.title: Musiikki liikkeen ja aivojen tukena
programme.desc: Musiikki tutkitusti virkistää ja aktivoi aivoja. Tässä jaksossa yhdistelemme musiikkia ja liikettä live-musiikin tahdissa. Tervetuloa mukaan hellimään aivoja musiikin ja liikkeen avulla. Harjoitus sopii kaikille katsojille.

programme.title: Tanssillinen jumppa
programme.desc: Tanssillinen jumppa toteutetaan tänään seisoen, mutta voit tulla mukaan myös istuen. Tule vetreyttämään kehoa musiikin tahtiin ja heittäydy rytmin vietäväksi. Liikkuminen ja koordinaation harjoittaminen tapahtuu huomaamatta, kun on hauskaa.
